items.titleZh: 尤里恩·廷贝尔接受英超重磅专访
items.summaryZh: 廷贝尔畅谈加盟阿森纳的梦想、伤愈复出及更多内容
bodyZh: 为阿森纳效力是全球成千上万年轻球员的共同愿望，尤里恩·廷贝尔在2023年加盟我们时实现了这个梦想。
我们的荷兰后卫在上赛季因伤错过了大部分比赛，但在本赛季强势回归，各项赛事出场47次，这让他在阿森纳的总出场数达到了50场。
廷贝尔近日在索布哈·雷亚尔训练基地接受英超重磅专访时，回忆了他为从小支持的俱乐部签约时的特殊感受。
“在这里踢球一直是我的梦想，毫无疑问……你可以看出他们在这里确实在打造一些伟大的成就。所以当他们找上门时，在我的内心深处，我知道，好的，这就是我的俱乐部，我想为他们效力。”
“在最初的对话中，你能感受到这是不同的级别，这是一是一家大俱乐部，显然那个夏天也是，我认为他们签下了德克兰、凯和大卫。他们正在做出一些重大的举措，而我非常渴望成为其中的一部分。”
转会阿森纳对任何球员的职业生涯来说都是一个重要时刻，但我们的边后卫自幼和家人一起看我们比赛起，就一直梦想着穿上那身标志性的红白战袍。
“我想我最大的哥哥是阿森纳球迷，我妈妈也是，所以你就顺理成章地接受了。我们小时候在家总是看阿森纳的比赛，然后你就自然而然地成了一名球迷。那些球员，我一直很喜欢这家俱乐部的风格。然后你会对一家俱乐部产生某种热爱，这种情感从很小的时候就开始了。”
本赛季尤里恩一直是球队的主力，但在英超首秀中遭遇十字韧带受伤后，他在上赛季仅有3次出场。不过，我们的12号一如既往地保持积极，将康复期视为学习的机会，并谈到了在场边观战的经历。
“在那段时期过后，我能感受到我身边有一些很好的人，我认为这非常重要。没有他们，我不可能像本赛季这样完成复出。还有俱乐部以及家里的亲友，大家都在谈论信念、信仰并坚持下去，这对我很有帮助。”
“你看着球队，心里会想，哇，他们太棒了！水平真的很高，如果我想加入这支球队，我必须达到同样的水平。”
当廷贝尔重返球场时，他延续了荷兰球员代表阿森纳最高水平出战的悠久传统，这位后卫对此感到非常自豪。
“我认为这是一件美好的事情，希望我也能做到这一点！[丹尼斯]博格坎普几个月前来看过一场比赛，我和他聊过。[马克]奥维马斯是我在阿贾克斯时就认识的，[罗宾]范佩西和[他的弟弟]昆滕现在在费耶诺德执教，我和他们不常联系，但我很了解他们。”
廷贝尔接着谈到了他有多么享受在我们这条稳固的防线中踢球，特别是随着本赛季迈尔斯·刘易斯-斯凯利的崭露头角。
“这太不可思议了。我想说这孩子，但他已经不再是个孩子了。我认为他非常成熟，他很特别。他在最大的舞台上做到这一点，以我的踢球经验我知道这并不容易。他轻而易举地做到了，而在球场外他又那么温和友善，你在场上看不到那种被释放的野兽般的气场，我真的很喜欢这一点。”
“但对于整条后防线来说，我认为水平高得惊人。我认为我们互相激励，而我很幸运能成为其中一员。”
观看文章顶部的完整专访，了解更多关于廷贝尔在荷兰国家队的经历、他对本赛季剩余时间的期望以及他在阿贾克斯的时光。

items.titleEn: Mikel Merino stars in the PL's Big Interview
items.summaryEn: Our Spanish international reflects on his first season in London, his glut of goals and hopes for the rest of the campaign
bodyEn: It might not have looked like it given how well he’s adapted, but Mikel Merino has been learning all about how to be a striker in recent weeks.
Our goalscoring Spaniard began his shift to the number nine role when a plethora of injuries tempted Mikel Arteta to try something new away to Leicester City.
Speaking recently in The Big Interview with the Premier League on a sunny day at Sobha Realty Training Centre, Merino spoke about that instruction from the coaching staff and his rich vein of form.

“Well, in the message they sent me, they didn’t think it was overly important, saying that I could play as a striker, they just mentioned it as a possibility,” he explained. “They asked me how I felt, what I thought about it, and if I felt comfortable, or if I felt that I could adapt myself to that situation.
"I said that I had no problem, that I would do whatever the team needed, and that I’d adapt to any circumstance. So, I came onto the pitch for 20 minutes, scored two goals.

“Did I know I would score? You always come on with the idea of helping the team out, but whenever I come onto the pitch, I always try to make a difference, providing positive energy to my team-mates, helping out both defensively and in attack when you’re fresh-legged. So, I came on with that mentality, did what I had to do, the balls dropped to my feet, and helped out.

“When you’re a kid you want to be a striker, but end up moving backwards! With the forwards we have here at Arsenal and some advice from the backroom staff, coaches who, depending on where my team-mates are, teach me where to position myself tactically, where to be to have an advantage, and, obviously, with the forwards here, to learn some technical tricks, how to make the most of those one-on-ones against the centre-back.
“But each player is unique and, ultimately, you have to find your own tools, and ways of gaining an advantage. So, I do what I believe works for me.

“It was really surprising when we started talking about the possibility of playing there, and I was kind of nervous at the beginning, as I wasn’t sure how to go about it, or what I had to do. But after a few weeks and games playing in that position, I can say that I feel comfortable there, that my team-mates are also understanding me and my characteristics on the pitch, and it’s working out well, so I’m very happy.”
One Arsenal supporter who has been enjoying Merino’s goals is actress Anne Hathaway, who recorded a wholesome video message following our 3-0 win at home to Real Madrid.
“At first I thought it was fake or something! I’m also a big fan of Anne, I’ve seen many of her movies, so it’s great to receive her support,” Merino added.
Just as common as the sight of Merino finding the back of the net is the image of him running around a corner flag in celebration, a nod to his father who used to mark goals in the same way.

“It’s something I’ve been doing my whole career,” he said. “Ever since my debut, every time I score, that’s how I celebrate. And since I look up to my dad so much, I kind of stole it from him! It’s my way of honouring him, so every time I score, I do it.

“The story goes that one day, my grandmother was feeling a bit unwell, and my dad had a game that day. He told her ‘don’t worry, I’m going to score a goal and dedicate it to you.’ He didn’t know how he was going to do it, just that he would, and it just so happened that he did score. He ran over to the corner flag, and since it was the first thing he saw, he ran around it; kind of like a tribute for my grandmother, to show her that the goal was for her, and that’s how the celebration was born.”
Merino went on to discuss how much he’s feeling at home during his first season with us, settling in and even enjoying spells of the English climate.

“Yes, I feel great here, happy, especially with this weather! I feel at home. Obviously, it takes time, there are transition periods where you have to adapt, not only to a new language and a new league, but a new environment, a new way of communicating, new team-mates.
“It’s still an ongoing process because I think I still have more steps to take, but I’m very pleased to be here, and I feel settled.”

Press play on the video at the top of the article to find out more about what life was like for Merino growing up in northern Spain, that famous photo of him in an Arsenal kit as a youngster, looking up to Thierry Henry and Cesc Fabregas, and more.

items.titleZh: 米克尔·梅里诺接受英超重磅专访
items.summaryZh: 梅里诺谈论伦敦首个赛季、近期进球及对未来的期望。
bodyZh: 考虑到他的适应能力有多强，你可能看不出来，但米克尔·梅里诺在最近几周一直在学习如何成为一名中锋。
这位为阿森纳进球如麻的西班牙球员开始转型担任9号位，源于米克尔·阿尔特塔在客场对阵莱斯特城时遭遇大面积伤病，不得不尝试新战术。
近日，在索布哈·雷蒂训练中心的一个阳光明媚的日子里，梅里诺接受了英超官方《重磅专访》的采访，谈到了教练组的战术指导以及他出色的竞技状态。
“嗯，在他们发给我的信息中，他们并没有觉得这有多么重要，只是说我可以踢前锋，并把它当作一种可能性，”他解释道。“他们问我感觉如何，对此有何看法，以及我是否感到舒适，或者觉得自己能否适应那种情况。
“我说我没有问题，球队需要我做什么我就做什么，我会适应任何情况。于是，我替补登场20分钟，打进两球。
“我知道自己会进球吗？你登场时总是带着帮助球队的想法，但每当我踏上球场，我总是试图发挥作用，给队友带来积极的能量，当体能充沛时在防守和进攻端都给予支援。所以，我带着这种心态上场，做了我必须做的事，皮球落到了我的脚下，然后完成了进球。
“当你还是个孩子时，你想成为一名中锋，但最终却越踢越靠后！有了阿森纳阵中的前锋们，再加上教练组的一些建议，他们会根据我队友的位置，教我在战术上如何跑位、如何占据优势，当然，还有向这里的锋线球员学习一些技术诀窍，以及如何在一对一对阵中卫时发挥最大作用。
“但每个球员都是独一无二的，最终你必须找到自己的工具和获取优势的方法。所以，我只做我认为对我有用的事。
“当我们开始讨论在那里踢球的可能性时，这真的很令人惊讶，一开始我有点紧张，因为我不太确定该怎么做，或者我必须做些什么。但在踢了这个位置几周和几场比赛之后，我可以说明我感到很适应，我的队友也理解我在球场上的特点，一切进展得很顺利，所以我非常高兴。”
有一位一直在享受梅里诺进球的阿森纳球迷是女演员安妮·海瑟薇，她在我们主场3-0战胜皇家马德里后录制了一条暖心的视频信息。
“一开始我以为那是假的或者什么的！我也是安妮的超级粉丝，我看过她很多电影，所以能得到她的支持真是太棒了，”梅里诺补充道。
伴随着梅里诺破门得分的常见场景，是他绕着角旗区庆祝的画面，这是对他的父亲的致敬，他的父亲过去也用同样的方式庆祝进球。
“这是我整个职业生涯一直在做的事情，”他说。“从我的首秀开始，每次我进球，我都是这样庆祝的。由于我非常崇拜我的父亲，我有点从他那里‘偷’来了这个庆祝动作！这是我向他致敬的方式，所以每次我进球，我都会这么做。
“故事是这样的，有一天，我祖母感觉身体有点不舒服，我父亲那天有一场比赛。他对她说‘别担心，我要进一个球并把它献给你。’他当时不知道自己会怎么做到这一点，只知道自己一定会进球，结果他真的进球了。他跑向角旗区，由于那是他看到的第一个东西，他便绕着它跑了起来；有点像是对祖母的致敬，向她表明这个进球是献给她的，这个庆祝动作就这样诞生了。”
梅里诺接着谈到了他在阿森纳的第一个赛季里感觉多么像在家里，他不仅适应了环境，甚至还享受了一段时间的英国气候。
“是的，我在这里感觉很好，很开心，尤其是伴随着这样的天气！我感觉就像在家一样。显然，这需要时间，这是一个需要适应的过渡期，不仅要适应新语言和新联赛，还要适应新环境、新的沟通方式以及新队友。
“这仍然是一个正在进行中的过程，因为我认为我还有更多的路要走，但我很高兴来到这里，而且我感觉已经安顿下来了。”

items.titleEn: Can Theo Walcott recreate Trossard's best goals?
items.summaryEn: Arsenal past and present try to replicate some of Leo's top strikes
bodyEn: When it comes to top-class wing play, two of the best to do it for ourselves in the Premier League era are Theo Walcott and Leandro Trossard.

The duo recently met at the Sobha Realty Training Centre for a Premier League Masterclass, where our former Gunner chatted to our current wideman about his role in the team, and the secrets behind his brilliant scoring season.

Only Bukayo Saka netted more times for us than Leandro's 17 in all competitions last term, and the Belgian gave some insight into the special tricks he has to get goals, and Theo tried to put those tips into practice by attempting to recreate some of his best strikes this season.

Theo had a go at replicating Leo's instinctive finish at Everton, counter-attack completion against Crystal Palace, his scoop to net against Brighton and a fine curler into the top corner at West Ham United.
Take a look at how he fared by pressing play on the video above.

items.titleEn: Arteta on the Wenger values he now uses himself
items.summaryEn: Our current boss has paid tribute to Arsène Wenger after a statue of him was unveiled at Emirates Stadium
bodyEn: Mikel Arteta has paid tribute to Arsène Wenger, saying he tries to implement many of our legendary manager’s traits into his own way of working.
The Frenchman has been honoured with a new statue outside Emirates Stadium to celebrate his 22-year tenure between 1996 and 2018, which yielded three Premier League titles and seven FA Cups.

And the man currently in charge of our men’s first team believes the accolade is fully warranted, having played under Arsène for five seasons before embarking on his own coaching career - a move he revealed had been anticipated by Wenger for many years.

“It’s such a great tribute that the club has done something special for Arsène that he fully deserves and merits,” Mikel said. “With a statue now at the stadium, Arsène can have that recognition and be here at our club forever.
“I’m so grateful to have played for Arsène at this club in my career. He chose me to be one of his players and selected me to be the captain of the club and that's something I will never forget.

“Towards the end of my playing career, I started to speak with Arsène about going into coaching and management myself, and he told me he had already anticipated that. Even the first year when I got here, he said to me: ‘one day you are going to be a manager’, and I wasn't really thinking about that at that time.”

That was just one example of Arsène’s eye for talent and visionary nature, and Mikel admits there are so many other characteristics that he picked up from one of the game’s greatest managers that he tries to implement on a daily basis - on and off the field.
“I learned so much from him and if I had to pick one of his many great values, it is how loyal he was and how much he defended the club, its players and football in general,” our current boss added.

“The passion he has for the game is just phenomenal and you could see that. He really wanted to respect the game and he wanted it to be played in a certain way. Also, the way he always put the club in front of any personal interest at all times is something that I have tried to learn from him.
“The way he defended the club, the way he presented himself, the way he was loyal to the players and his staff is something that I really took from him. He is an example for me.”
Hear much more from Mikel on Arsène in our Emirates Cup programme, available to or purchase on the day around Emirates Stadium.
